tutorial.text: Walk to the pier tip — stand where the boards meet the water
Catch 3 fish: hold Cast, then tap Reel while the meter is green
Carry fish onto the teal In pad on the cutter's left
Pick up portions from the Out pad on the cutter's right
Stock the counter pad so waiting customers can buy
Stay at the counter — sales ring up when the pad has stock
Open Upgrades and buy a bigger bag with your sale coins
Open Jobs, accept a harbor contract, then deliver the listed goods
After Make 10 sales unlocks hiring, open Staff and hire your first hand
When the grill unlocks, deliver fish to the charcoal In pad
Stand on an expansion marker and confirm spend to place a new pad
